1924, October
FR. SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 1
Page 16 Cont.
Oct. 7 Consumption Averted. Adam Bolde (31 - 7622 Morgan) Enrolled Sep. 25th perpetually as against tuberculosis comes back with two other enrollments Sept. 28 "ten % improved." Goes to work after 3 mos. October 6th
7 Enrolled against cancerous nose and Deafness. Mrs. Sarah McKee 64, of 6537 Sherwood Ave., suffering from bad tincils and defness since March, when she had the "Flue: Also from sore nose about a year joins to-day - perpetually. N.B. "Pimple" on nose grow- ing and becoming very sore looks like cancer.
14 Probable Cancer in stomach Charles Jos Cunning ( 70 of 566 Con- cord Ave) Given up by doctor now laying in bed a week - two yrs invalid, enrolled for one yr.
20 Mary Ellen Yarr (4 of 2510 Lemothe) subnormal and mentally - quite so - doctors helpless. Novenas to different saints for two years - 5 novenas to St. Ann alone etc. No. improvement.
22 Helen Weeks sickly and frequently invalid - going to Harber Hos- pital tomorrow for operation, anxious lest it be serious
Finantial Difficulties Settled. (Martin Snell) enrolled for year by Elise Coyle to whom for 8 months the former had owed $2000.00 - lost to detectives and friends. Same E.C. Enrolled him for - One week after enrollment phons to debtor to come to see him. Now seems well disposed. Victor LeJeune Enrolled same time.
23rd Adema & Dropsey - Last stages - Mrs. Stella Jankowski age 35 - 2667 Common Ave, given up by five doctors as hopeless is en- rolled this evening for yr. by discouraged Eusband
Br. Raynerius, O.M.Cap. Hopeless case in St. Joseph's Retreat is enrolled this evening for yr. by Mary (0'S) Mccarthy at 8:30
25 Mary Dewey 4 of 5073 Seebaldt - Away subnormal - no effort to talk or walk Can sit only when held. Enrolled perpetually To-day.
Page 17 Oct. 28 Enrolled Husband and Son for change - conversion Former not to Sa- craments in at least 10 yrs. Mrs. Eliz. Larivee 4820 Seyburn (51 yrs.) deeply lamenting absolute indifference as regards religion in Husband and son Allen 17 following footsteps of Father, enrolles both To-day for yr.
